glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 丁 + semantic 止 Oracle bone and Shang–Zhou bronze forms show 丁 with 止. Some late Western Zhou and early Spring and Autumn bronze forms reduce 丁 to a horizontal stroke joined to 止. Later bronze and Chu bamboo forms often show 上 over 止; one-stroke forms also occur in Chu bamboo slips. In oracle bone script, the graph is used for the word later written 征.
senses: [zhèng] straight; upright in proper position; middle
[zhēng] (obsolete in standard Chinese) bull's eye; centre of target
